h: Wike reportedly promises a federal appointment to a PDP candidate who stepped down for the APC
p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly said a PDP candidate who withdrew from a race in favour of the APC will be given an appointment by President Tinubu. The remark, said to have been made at a political gathering, has drawn reaction from opposition parties.
more: The candidate was not named in the report.
The APC has been welcoming defectors and withdrawals ahead of 2027.
